title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton: on 2 fresh seeds the catalyst dies by t~100 and the vesicles are decaying remnants (Weak)
summary: Labkit re-runs of the claim's world.py (unchanged) on seeds 11 and 12, and world_starve.py on seed 11. On both fresh seeds bilayers and multilamellar vesicles form from the noisy bath by t~50-80 (S, I), but the catalyst K goes extinct by t~100 (channel total drift K -1.0, timeseries.png) and no vesicle carries a K layer. With no K there is no amphiphile production, and total amphiphile falls 99% by t=600 (drift -0.990 on both seeds, against +0.08 on the claim's seeds 0 and 2 and -0.44 on seed 1), while P saturates at its fed value. What survives to t=600 is one (seed 11) or two (seed 12) small rings shrinking slowly by decay (sheet.png). The starved arm on seed 11 is identical to the fed run, since nothing consumes P after t~100. Reading the code: K is a Gray-Scott autocatalyst whose mobility is shut by the bilayer (min-face gate exp(-4(u+1)), written against u); it beads on bilayers because it cannot diffuse away there, and it is made in place (aK^2P), so the K layer is self-made where it exists. Amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays everywhere, so E holds by construction where K survives.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0 -> 51: vesicles and multilamellar bilayers from the uniform noisy bath (also rerun12/sheet.png)
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: one multilamellar vesicle persists t~50-600, shrinking to a small ring; rerun12/sheet.png: two rings persist t~150-600

seeds_run.result: fail: K extinct by t~100, amphiphile -99% by t=600, no K layer, vesicle decays

controls_run.E: starve/ (world_starve.py, seed 11): identical to the fed run because K is already extinct, so the fork is uninformative on this seed

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds only; the claim's seeds 0 and 2 keep K (drift -0.76) and amphiphile (+0.08), so K survival is seed-dependent and my 0/2 does not measure its rate. The claimed individuals (vesicles carrying the gated catalyst, kept up by production from the fed precursor) did not appear on either of my seeds, so I cannot support B or E. Where K does survive, its layer is a self-made quasi-equilibrium layer (it counts under the L3 clause) and E is by construction (build-from-food with decay).
